name: Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, Galvan the Ancient prepares enchanted arms against a powerful demon. Their Felcurse is meant to weaken Razelikh the Defiler and his servitors.

sections.title: A Weapon Against the Defiler
sections.body: Just south of the path into Zul'Gurub, Galvan the Ancient works with care. Forging a blade, staff, or dagger takes patience, and haste risks a flaw. Each weapon bears the Felcurse, which can be unleashed from time to time against Razelikh the Defiler and his demonic underlings. Its weakening effect lasts for different lengths of time.

faq.answer: Galvan the Ancient, a master smith, forges the weapons just south of the road toward Zul'Gurub in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What power does the forged weapon hold?
faq.answer: Each weapon channels the Felcurse, magic meant to weaken Razelikh the Defiler and his demonic minions. The effect lasts for different lengths of time.

faq.q: Where does the journey lead after the weapon is forged?
faq.answer: When Galvan finishes and presents the weapon, you return along the path with Return to the Blasted Lands.
